services.name: Ultimate 1000 Islands Sightseeing Tour / Including Picnic Lunch
services.desc: Join us for the Ultimate Sightseeing Tour on the St. Lawrence River designed for those who wish to take in the beauty of the 1000 islands Region and experience the the most attractions on the river in an afternoon. Visit Boldt Castle on Heart Island to explore Millionaire George Boldt's Rhineland Style Castle, cruise "Millionaires Row" to view magnificent summer homes of the rich and famous of the gilded age, and enjoy Rock Island Lighthouse on Rock Island, Your Boat, Captain and Crew will be with

services.name: Islands, Lighthouses, and Castle Tour
services.desc: Duration 2 Hours About Join us for a two hour tour in the heart of the 1000 Islands on the St. Lawrence River. Our narrator/guide shares history of the area and points out highlights on a 20 mile journey through many of the islands between Clayton and Alexandria Bay. Sights include Boldt Castle on Heart Island, Sunken Rock Lighthouse on Bush island, Rock Island Lighthouse on Rock Island, Million dollar homes, Millionaires Row , and we may even get up close to a Great Lakes Freighter or "Salty" as they travel the Seaway Shipping Channel to/from the Great Lakes and Ports around the world. 2025 Schedule Summer June 19 – September 2 / 3:00pm Daily Highlights of this Tour St. Lawrence Seaway

services.name: Autumn Sunset Cruise in the 1000 Islands
services.desc: Few natural phenomena generate as much excitement as the annual changing of the leaves from bright green to yellows and reds, and the 1000 Islands is no exception! Join us this fall for a relaxing 2 hour cruise on the St. Lawrence River, meandering among the beautiful islands on the St. Lawrence River during Autumn, when the region is burnished in fall colors, and later as the islands are cast in soft hues as the sun sets. The route is captain’s choice to show off their favorite area of the St. Lawrence river and the route may be different every day.
